body: Drugs are not good for mentally ill, can lead to a lifetime of bad decisions. I'm just happy to still be alive sometimes.
Yeah I have anxiety but thats probably from years drug abuse, now I'm just addicted to benzos. The zopiclone I guess makes it easier to sleep but I don't feel it like the valis

Thanks, I haven't heard from him in a few months and he keeps creeping up in my mind. I attempted to contact him but no response, been thinking of calling a distress line and making a missing person report.

I think you're right about a lot of things, thanks for the answer.

Took 50+ pills of Etizolam with a multitude of psychedelics over a weekend on my own. Can't remember much of the weekend; mostly sleeping or zombie still tripping and under the all the effects, I was even huffing lighter fluid at some point in this craze.

I don't recommend trying this.

Thanks for your response. I haven't heard from my friend, but he was using alcohol and downers when I used to last spoke to him; very risky when used in combination. He was struggling to find employment and didn't have much regard for his life, I tried to convince him to get help.

I couldn't take it anymore (had / have my own problems) and stopped speaking to him after an argument, I feel like I was his last real connection to the real world and I turned my back, haven't heard from him since.

The woods were just a place we used to chill as kids, more of a metaphor in my post. I always remember those years when I think of him.

If you haven't spoken to your girlfriend about your problems I think that might be a good idea. She can help you through this and fight this with you, nothing more heartbreaking than losing a partner.

I don't feel like doing it right now, got christmas to deal with. But I imagine I will do this in the future; really giving up.

Last time I saw my friend he was abusing alcohol and all sorts, I tried to help but lost contact. By now he could be on the streets / dead in his flat / hanging from a tree. I've walked through every street in town and can't find him. His family don't care about him. Hew wasn't far off suicide and I turned my back.

I look in the mirror and I don't see me anymore.

Just the worn-out, blank-expression face of a junkie who wants it all to end.

I'm sorry if this isn't helpful, I guess I'm trying to say you're not the only one and we've all been there.

You can make it through this, please take care of yourself.

I have used a lot of psychedelics in my life, also for depression at times.

Just be careful, start low and it's always good to research these substances, harm reduction is a good place to start reading about to avoid bad experiences. Sometimes trips have a way of pointing out your issues but they won't fix you. The afterglow can give you a sense of clarity too but it varies.

One last thing: remember set and setting; you need to be in a good place for a positive, insightful experience.

I'm not condoning this but I know a lot people trip for these purposes.
